source_scope.authoritative_document: ADS语兴好物（y shopping）电商数据表.md
source_scope.scope_rule: This slice covers candidate assets without an authoritative ODS domain that have a same-name CREATE in the ADS document. ADS assets are purpose-limited analytical products; DWD tables declared here are rejected as ADS authority and retained only as governed source evidence.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Same-name CREATE plus explicit analytical grain, denominator, source event/version, privacy class, time window, output boundary, authority and correction rules.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Non-empty production recomputation from governed canonical facts with full eligible denominator, stable watermarks, exact time windows, privacy controls, independent metric/content comparison and zero unexplained differences.

customer_service_workforce_metrics.grain: one tenant, effective worker assignment or service queue and exact declared reporting window
metric_rules: ticket counts use distinct canonical ticket ids and declared eligible states
response and resolution durations use paired immutable events in one timezone
worker identity uses effective assignment rather than display name
quality and satisfaction numerators publish their exact eligible denominators
reopened transferred automated and abandoned tickets are explicitly classified
metrics never create payroll authorization SLA waiver or ticket effects
customer_service_workforce_metrics.security: Worker and customer PII is minimized or pseudonymized; coaching access is purpose-bound and audited.
customer_service_workforce_metrics.authority: Customer Service owns tickets, Workforce owns assignments and Quality owns accepted reviews; ADS is read-only.

risk_case_content_projection.grain: one tenant, governed case or pseudonymous subject and exact as-of window
metric_rules: keyword OCR and model outputs remain typed signals with policy/model versions
raw ticket content attachments and OCR text are never broad analytical dimensions
high-refund and frequent-complaint numerators publish complete eligible denominators
refund compensation and loss money use integer minor units ISO currency and owning-domain effects
group relation evidence is HMAC-linked and cannot be inferred from name phone or address alone
signals and scores never directly ban refund compensate or mutate a ticket
risk_case_content_projection.security: Content, attachments, identities and relations are restricted; ADS exposes redacted evidence references and aggregates.
risk_case_content_projection.authority: Risk owns decisions, Customer Service owns cases, AfterSales/Payment owns refunds and Compensation/Ledger owns loss effects.

customer_profile_analytics.grain: one tenant, pseudonymous canonical Principal and declared feature as-of time
metric_rules: every feature names its source event, event-time window and late-data policy
money is currency-partitioned integer minor units
order refund engagement and membership features use distinct owning-domain keys
missing unknown zero and not-applicable remain different
feature versions and consent purpose are retained
profile scores never grant membership credit moderation or marketing eligibility
customer_profile_analytics.security: Direct identifiers, addresses, devices, payment handles and legal identifiers are excluded; features are purpose-limited and erasable where legally required.
customer_profile_analytics.authority: Owning domains retain business authority; ADS only publishes governed features.

community_operations_metrics.grain: one tenant, community scope and exact calendar or rolling window
metric_rules: content interaction moderation and active-user facts preaggregate before joining
counts use stable event or content ids and explicit deduplication
active user and retention definitions publish eligible denominators
AI red-team traffic is isolated from real-user and production KPIs
timezone and late-event restatement are declared
dashboard results never create moderation distribution or engagement effects
community_operations_metrics.security: Raw content, reports, private messages and actor identity are restricted; outputs are aggregated and k-anonymous where needed.
community_operations_metrics.authority: Engagement and Moderation own facts; ADS is an operational analytical view.

monitoring_alert_delivery.grain: one tenant, metric definition version, evaluation window and alert delivery attempt
metric_rules: metric SQL and expected schema bind to immutable approved versions
evaluation value threshold and outcome preserve units and timestamps
late missing stale and query-error states are distinct
alert deduplication and suppression use stable incident keys
Kafka delivery records attempt acknowledgement and retry rather than business success
LLM summaries are advisory and cannot change alert state without an accepted operation
monitoring_alert_delivery.security: SQL text, infrastructure identifiers and alert payloads are restricted; connector credentials remain external secrets.
monitoring_alert_delivery.authority: Observability owns observations/incidents and Operations owns effects; ADS and Kafka outputs are projections.

intelligence_signal_delivery.grain: one tenant, governed signal or collection task and immutable event/detail version
metric_rules: third-party collection retains provider source terms event time and payload digest
content and image references are redacted and object-store uploads retain digest lineage
AI category and overview metrics bind model taxonomy and policy versions
realtime current views do not erase signal or delivery history
Kafka output records delivery attempts acknowledgements and replay ids
signals and summaries never directly enforce Risk or Community effects
intelligence_signal_delivery.security: Third-party content, personal data, image objects and intelligence payloads are restricted by purpose and retention policy.
intelligence_signal_delivery.authority: Source collection owns observations, AI Operations owns attempts and Risk/Community owns accepted decisions.

catalog_listing_attribution.grain: one tenant, listing approval attempt and immutable catalog/listing/review versions
metric_rules: first-pass success is defined from ordered immutable review attempts
attribution dimensions use versions effective at the attempt time
operator and reviewer identities use canonical Principal assignments
missing review attempts and auto-approved flows are explicitly classified
correlation and attribution remain separate from causal proof
analytical attribution cannot approve publish or alter a Listing
catalog_listing_attribution.security: Reviewer/operator identities and review comments are restricted; outputs expose minimized aggregates.
catalog_listing_attribution.authority: Catalog owns product identity, Listing owns publish state and Quality owns accepted review.

ai_usage_observability.grain: one tenant, immutable invocation attempt or model/user reporting window
metric_rules: attempt request run and workflow identities are distinct
input output total token conservation is checked per provider response
latency success retry timeout and cancellation use versioned status semantics
quota and cost use integer units and immutable PricingVersion
user profiles use canonical Principal mapping rather than username
observability never debits quota settles payment grants access or changes workflow state
ai_usage_observability.security: Prompts, responses, user identity, credentials and provider traces are restricted; outputs are redacted aggregates.
ai_usage_observability.authority: AI Operations owns execution, Token Platform owns usage/quota and Payment owns settlement; ADS is read-only.

metadata_observability.grain: one tenant, governed metadata asset/task/check version and exact observation or alert window
metric_rules: asset task metric and quality-check identities are versioned and separately typed
run delay failure waiting SLA and restore derive from ordered immutable observations
every threshold and expected schedule binds to an approved policy version
ninety-day windows use exact half-open boundaries and late-data policy
AI helper input/output retains prompt/model/version lineage without becoming metadata authority
Kafka and object-store rows record delivery/storage evidence rather than governance effects
metadata_observability.security: SQL, lineage, task parameters, owners and AI prompts are restricted; secrets remain external vault references.
metadata_observability.authority: Metadata owns asset/task definitions, Data Quality owns check results and Operations owns alert effects.

supply_chain_efficiency.grain: one tenant, governed operation or effective worker assignment and exact reporting window
metric_rules: receipt sorting quality and outbound operations use stable physical-operation ids
duration requires paired milestones and one timezone
BPO identity uses effective workforce assignment and excludes payroll fields
AI quality accuracy publishes eligible case and accepted human-review denominators
attribution distinguishes controllable cause from correlation
metrics never change inventory quality employment or listing state
supply_chain_efficiency.security: Worker PII, payroll, images, model evidence and warehouse details are restricted and purpose-bound.
supply_chain_efficiency.authority: Warehouse/WMS owns operations, Workforce owns assignments, Quality owns review and AI Operations owns attempts.

merchant_analytics.grain: one tenant, canonical Merchant or Shop and immutable feature as-of time
metric_rules: Merchant Shop LegalEntity and operator identities remain separate
features declare source event windows and version selection
money uses integer minor units and ISO currency
AI recommendations retain model prompt and source-feature lineage
missing and not-applicable features remain explicit
profiles and assistant outputs never grant onboarding listing settlement or credit effects
merchant_analytics.security: Legal, bank, contact and operator data are vaulted/tokenized; AI inputs and outputs are restricted.
merchant_analytics.authority: Merchant owns identities, Payment/Ledger owns money and AI Operations owns attempts; ADS is advisory.

wrong_layer_operational_source.grain: one immutable governed source fact or transport envelope referenced by ADS
metric_rules: DWD objects declared in ADS are rejected as ADS outputs
source schema event identity and payload digest are retained
event time ingestion time and replay checkpoint are distinct
tenant and source identity are validated
poison and duplicate records remain auditable
only purpose-limited ADS projections may consume these facts
wrong_layer_operational_source.security: Raw content and connector payloads are restricted; credentials remain external secrets.
wrong_layer_operational_source.authority: DWD preserves source facts; it is not an ADS metric or business-effect authority.
